components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when present it is one of

          type: string

                region), the 2-digit fiscal-year code FY of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on

                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                the normalized lastName and postcode. Every owner sharing the same
                lastName and postcode is assigned the same householdId
                automatically.

              example: '3C1A9F2B7D4E'
              readOnly: true

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true

                present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3

                year.

              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4

              maximum: 4
              example: 2

              readOnly: true

                locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true

                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3

                Whether, at the time this owner was created, its city was
                approaching the owner capacity limit of 50: true when the city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners, otherwise false. The hard
                rejection at 50 is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+', the
                country calling code, a space, and the national digits grouped in
                threes separated by spaces. The raw telephone stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true

                lower-case hex SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone, the
                email (lower-cased, or empty when absent) and the Soundex of the
                lastName, joined with '|' before hashing. Two owners are
                duplicates, and the second is rejected with 409, only when their
                whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3c1a9f2b7d4e5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0011223344556677889900aabbccddee'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,

              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-

                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. The
                owner is still created; true flags the soft match, otherwise
                false.

              example: false
              readOnly: true

                when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
